title: Regulatory controls milestone index and cycle playbook for evidence aggregation
creator: Lena Martinez
description: Objective: Define a cycle-aligned milestone index + playbook that operationalizes end-to-end evidence aggregation for SOC2/ISO controls, SSO/SAML onboarding, and audit-log retention. Deliver a single living artifact (milestone index) that maps controls -> artifacts -> owners -> gating criteria -> cycle commitments. Purpose: reduce manual evidence assembly time, shorten customer onboarding for Dedicated/Private, and provide clear gate checks for releases.
acceptance_criteria: Milestone index document published in Confluence with mapping for top 20 SOC2 controls + ISO analogs
Owners assigned for each milestone and linked to Linear tickets
Gating criteria defined in checklist form (e.g., KMS key rotation policy, audit-log retention test, SSO metadata validation) and automatable where possible
Evidence automation backlog created with prioritized items and estimates: at least 3 automation stories slated this cycle
Runbook for cyclical evidence refresh (monthly) and incident escalation documented
Dashboard KPIs defined: manual-evidence-hours, on-boarding lead-time, evidence coverage %, stale-evidence count
description_long: Background: Multiple teams own fragments of regulatory readiness: infra produces logs, security defines controls, console owns evidence export flows, and product manages customer onboarding. Current problems: (1) Evidence lives in disparate places (S3, BigQuery, Drive), (2) manual packaging during customer audits, (3) unclear gate criteria for releases that claim 'SOC2-ready'. Scope: this ticket produces the milestone index + playbook for cycles through Q2 2026, and creates the initial set of automation stories to show >50% coverage for core controls.
milestone_summary: M1 (2026-03 cycle): Publish milestone index + owner RACI; define 10 gating checklists (SSO metadata, SAML assertions, audit-log schema, retention config, KMS audit trail)
M2 (2026-04 cycle): Deliver automation for audit-log retention verification, and automated evidence export for two SOC2 controls; end-to-end test harness (CI) added
M3 (2026-05 cycle): SSO self-test tooling for customer onboarding and canary audit to validate metadata propagation across regions
M4 (2026-06 cycle): Achieve automated packaging for 60% of evidence items required for standard enterprise readiness; run a dry-run internal audit
gating_criteria: Checklist items must be binary or scriptable (pass/fail) where feasible
At least one contraint test per control executed in CI and green in staging
Owners must supply links to raw evidence and an automated verification path or documented manual process
Security sign-off required for any changes to KMS/audit logging or retention policies
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Infra bandwidth limited for building verification hooks. Mitigation: prioritize read-only verification tests initially and schedule infra work in ENG-5016.
Risk: Evidence sources are inconsistent across environments. Mitigation: create normalization layer in M2 and mark items with 'env-sensitivity' flag in index.
Risk: SSO metadata churn causing flakiness. Mitigation: add metadata hash validation and retention of last-known-good config for canary rollouts.
